mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 2% does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 5% and rising does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the last two months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST increase > 10% does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is increasing, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of UNRATE < 4% and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is stable, it signals accommodative monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with stable inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS < 2% and stable CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.
